title: Soap and Stars
source_detail: Cleanliness is half of faith — the Prophet's teaching on taharah
description: Little Zara learns to wash her hands before every meal and make wudu before prayer. She discovers that being clean on the outside helps her feel bright and sparkly on the inside.

pages.text: Zara was playing in the garden, making mud pies and chasing a tiny ladybug. Her hands were happy, but a little bit messy from all the fun. The sun was setting, painting the sky with soft, sleepy colors.
pages.illustration_prompt: A little girl, Zara (ages 3-5, visible face, big expressive cartoon eyes), with a bright pink dress and pigtails, sitting happily in a lush green garden. Her hands are covered in a little bit of mud from making a small mud pie. A tiny ladybug is on a green leaf nearby. The background shows a warm sunset with soft orange and pink hues, rich with visible brushstrokes. Mood: vibrant, warm, magical, inviting.

pages.text: "Zara, sweet pea, time for a yummy snack!" called Mama from the kitchen. Zara skipped inside, her tummy rumbling with happy anticipation. She saw a plate of juicy strawberries waiting.
pages.illustration_prompt: Zara skipping happily towards a kitchen doorway, her back slightly to the viewer but her joyful expression visible. In the background, Mama (warm, kind expression, visible face) is smiling, holding a plate of bright red, juicy strawberries on a wooden table. The kitchen has warm golden light, lush green plants on the windowsill, and visible brushstrokes. Mood: vibrant, warm, inviting, bedtime-ready.

pages.text: But before Zara could reach for a bright red berry, Mama gently stopped her. "First, let's wash those busy hands, my little star," Mama smiled. "Clean hands help us stay healthy and strong."
pages.illustration_prompt: Close-up of Zara's hands, still a little muddy, reaching for a strawberry on a plate. Mama's gentle hand (visible, warm skin tone) is softly stopping Zara's hand. Mama's face is partially visible in the background, smiling kindly. The kitchen background is still warm and inviting. Mood: gentle, warm, reassuring.

pages.text: Zara giggled as warm water splashed over her fingers. She rubbed the bubbly, sweet-smelling soap all around. Swish, swish, went the water, washing away all the garden dust and mud.
pages.illustration_prompt: Zara at a sink, with her visible face showing a joyful giggle. Her small hands are under a stream of warm water, covered in white, bubbly soap. The soap has a subtle, sweet scent depicted by small, swirling hearts or stars. The sink area is clean with warm lighting. Rich, detailed background with visible brushstrokes. Mood: joyful, clean, bright.

pages.text: Her hands felt so smooth and fresh, like tiny polished stones. They sparkled under the kitchen light. "Look, Mama!" Zara cheered, holding up her clean, happy hands for Mama to see.
pages.illustration_prompt: Close-up of Zara's freshly washed hands, held up towards the viewer. They are visibly clean, smooth, and have tiny, subtle sparkles around them. In the soft-focus background, Mama is smiling warmly, looking at Zara's hands. The kitchen light casts a warm, golden glow. Mood: triumphant, fresh, bright, warm.

pages.text: Later, as the stars began to peek out, Mama spread her prayer mat. "It's time for Salah, my dear," she whispered. Zara loved watching Mama pray, feeling peaceful in her heart.
pages.illustration_prompt: Mama (visible face, peaceful expression) is gently unfolding a beautiful prayer mat with intricate patterns, perhaps in deep blues and golds, on a soft rug. Through a window in the background, early evening stars are just beginning to appear in a deep blue sky. Zara (visible face, curious, peaceful expression) is sitting nearby, watching Mama with wonder. Mood: peaceful, contemplative, warm.

pages.text: Mama showed Zara how to make wudu, washing her face, arms, and feet. "Wudu helps us feel clean and ready to talk to Allah," Mama explained gently, pouring a little water.
pages.illustration_prompt: Mama demonstrating wudu at a low basin or tap, gently washing her own arm. Water is flowing gracefully. Zara is beside her, watching intently, her visible face full of curiosity. Mama's expression is gentle and teaching. The setting is a clean, serene bathroom with soft light and deep blue tiles. Mood: educational, gentle, calm.

pages.text: Zara carefully washed her own little hands and face, feeling the cool water. She splashed her feet, giggling softly. It felt like a tiny, special bath just for prayer time.
pages.illustration_prompt: Zara at the same basin, carefully washing her small hands and splashing her feet in the water, a soft giggle on her visible face. Water droplets are playfully depicted. The background shows soft, warm colors, perhaps a warm gold or pink on the walls. Mood: playful, clean, special.

pages.text: After wudu, Zara felt wonderfully fresh and bright. Her heart felt light and ready. She knew she was clean on the outside, and that made her feel good on the inside too.
pages.illustration_prompt: Zara standing tall and looking content, her visible face serene and happy. She is wearing clean clothes, perhaps a simple prayer dress. A soft, inner glow is subtly emanating from her chest area, representing her light heart. The background is a soft, comforting blend of blues and golds. Mood: fresh, bright, serene, content.

pages.text: "Just like we wash our hands before eating, we make wudu before we pray," Mama said. "Cleanliness is a gift from Allah, making us pure for our prayers."
pages.illustration_prompt: Mama (visible face, warm expression) sitting next to Zara, gently holding Zara's hand. Zara is looking up at Mama, listening. A prayer mat is softly visible in the background. The scene is bathed in warm, soft light, perhaps from a nearby lamp. Mood: warm, loving, educational.

pages.text: Mama shared a special teaching from our beloved Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). "He taught us that 'Cleanliness is half of faith.' It makes our hearts shine!"
pages.illustration_prompt: A radiant silhouette of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), depicted from behind or as a golden light, gently guiding or teaching. No visible face. Below, Zara and Mama (visible faces, reverent expressions) are looking towards the light, their faces reflecting a soft golden glow. The background is a deep, peaceful blue, with subtle stars. Mood: reverent, wonder-filled, peaceful, magical.

pages.text: Zara imagined her heart shining like a little star, bright and sparkly. Being clean felt like a warm, happy secret inside her, ready to glow.
pages.illustration_prompt: An ethereal illustration of Zara's chest area, with her heart subtly glowing like a tiny, beautiful star. The light from the star gently expands outwards, filling her silhouette with a soft, warm radiance. Her visible face is peaceful and imaginative. The background is a cosmic blend of deep blues and purples with soft, distant stars. Mood: wonder-filled, magical, peaceful.

pages.text: She looked at her hands again. They weren't just clean; they felt special. Ready to draw, ready to hug, ready to lift in prayer.
pages.illustration_prompt: Close-up of Zara's clean hands, palms open and slightly cupped, as if ready to receive or give. There's a subtle, soft glow around them. In the soft-focus background, hints of crayons, a teddy bear, and a small prayer mat are visible, symbolizing readiness for different activities. Mood: hopeful, special, ready, warm.

pages.text: From her clean hands to her fresh wudu, Zara felt a wonderful sense of peace. Being clean made her feel good, inside and out, like a gentle, happy hum.
pages.illustration_prompt: Zara (visible face, serene smile) standing in a soft, warm light. Her whole body seems to have a gentle, peaceful aura. She might have her eyes softly closed, enjoying the feeling. The background is a seamless blend of soft greens, blues, and golds, creating a calming atmosphere. Mood: peaceful, serene, content.

pages.text: Now, tucked snug in her bed, Zara closed her eyes. She felt clean and loved, like the softest cloud. The day's sparkle stayed with her, a quiet, gentle glow.
pages.illustration_prompt: Zara tucked snugly in her bed, under a soft blanket, her eyes gently closed. Her visible face shows a peaceful, sleepy expression. A subtle, soft glow emanates from her. The bedroom is cozy with warm, deep blues and soft pinks, and a gentle night light. Mood: cozy, safe, peaceful, loved.

pages.text: Sleep well, little star. May your dreams be as bright and peaceful as your clean heart. Allah is always with you. Goodnight, sweet Zara.
pages.illustration_prompt: An overhead view of Zara sleeping peacefully in her bed, her visible face serene. Above her, a few soft, glowing stars twinkle gently. The room is dim but warm, with moonbeams gently filtering through a window. The overall mood is very calming and loving. Mood: peaceful, goodnight, loving, magical.
